svg.title: Known-best packing of 70 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=70 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete algebraic-number-field Witness/v2 of PR 574 at 4c319c2, read exactly from a release asset whose size and SHA-256 a manifest of that commit pins; no upstream byte is retained. Decided on one exact route, sqpack exact_verify over the witness's field; no second route over a number field is maintained. Finite construction feasibility only; an exact certificate of a construction others found, with no novelty, priority, local minimum, rigidity or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=70 known best: side ~ 8.880960372 (certified upper bound)
